verdict.rationale: Gazebo is itself a simulation environment, so it offers a natural sandbox for testing robot behavior instead of running on real systems. The docs support this with headless server-only runs, a lightweight server-only install, example SDF worlds you can freely copy and modify, and remote simulation over Gazebo Transport. However, nothing in the evidence frames this as an isolated sandbox versus production, or addresses keeping agent tests away from real data or hardware. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of sandbox/production separation, guidance for agent-driven isolated test runs, independent hands-on corroboration.
